notes: Settings → Companies → Documents: Aadhaar card and Jan Aadhaar card added. New Master → ✉ Write Email: choose the sending company first, then write a new email (To from the buyers or typed, CC, subject, message with ✨ Refine), tick the company documents to attach (GST, PAN, bank proof, MSME, Aadhaar, Jan Aadhaar, company details form) and drop in any other file. Company details email can also attach Aadhaar / Jan Aadhaar.
